---

A small gallery -- click any image to open the full-size version.

::: {.photo-grid}

```{python}
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path

EXTS = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".webp"}

source_candidates = [Path("photography"), Path("pages/Photos/photography")]
source_dir = next((p for p in source_candidates if p.exists()), None)
if source_dir is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Could not locate photos directory")

web_dir = source_dir.parent / "photography_derived" / "web"
thumb_dir = source_dir.parent / "photography_derived" / "thumbs"


def as_page_relative(path):
    parts = path.as_posix().split("pages/Photos/", 1)
    if len(parts) == 2:
        return parts[1]
    return path.as_posix()


images = sorted(
    p for p in source_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in EXTS
)

tiles = []
for image in images:
    web_image = web_dir / image.name
    thumb_image = thumb_dir / image.name

    full = web_image if web_image.exists() else image
    preview = thumb_image if thumb_image.exists() else full

    alt = image.stem.replace("_", " ").strip()
    preview_path = as_page_relative(preview)
    full_path = as_page_relative(full)

    tiles.append(
        f'[![]({preview_path})]({full_path}){{.lightbox group=\"photo-gallery\" title=\"{alt}\"}}'
    )

print("\n\n".join(tiles))
```

:::
